title: Moho vector mesh (points, curves, shapes)
description: A MeshLayer's `mesh` field: the vector artwork itself. See docs/moho-project-file-format.md §7 for the full field-by-field evidence, and §5.1/§7.5 for why the Bezier control points are reconstructed from smoothness/weight/offset rather than stored directly.

groups.description: Named point groups (an editor selection convenience, e.g. "Right Hand", "top lip") - not read by moho2svg.py. Distinct from a layer's flexi_bone_subset, which names BONE indices, not point indices.

shape_order.description: A "|"-joined ascending id registry of shape.id values - NOT a z-order, despite the name. The real z-order (back to front) is simply the order shapes already appear in `shapes`. Not read by moho2svg.py. See docs/moho-project-file-format.md §7.9.

anim_shape_order.description: Observed false in every sample. Presumably enables keyframing shape_order.

next_shape_id.description: The id allocator's next value. Not semantically meaningful for a reader.

curve_interpretation.description: Observed values: 1 (overwhelming majority), 0 (rare). Meaning not decoded; moho2svg.py does not branch on it.

type.description: Literally "Point", NOT "MeshPoint" - confirmed against every sampled document. The $def is named MeshPoint here only to disambiguate from Curve's own "point" (int, an index) and CurvePoint's own "point" field.

position.description: The point's position, in the layer's own local coordinate space (2 Moho units span the canvas height - see docs/moho-project-file-format.md §4).

width.description: Per-point stroke-width multiplier. Normally 1.0; a shape whose points do NOT all share one width renders as a tapered (filled-outline) stroke instead of a plain <path stroke>. See §7.6-7.7.

curves.description: The curves that pass through this point, as {curve, curve_points} pairs (NOT a plain array of curve indices, despite the field name). Not read by moho2svg.py - the reverse mapping is rebuilt from `curves` instead.

curve_points.description: Index into that curve's own points array.

parent.description: Point-level parenting. Not read by moho2svg.py.

colored.description: Whether per-point vertex colour (the `color` channel) is active. Observed false on every sampled point - this tool's disregard of `color`/`color_strength` is untested against a document with `colored: true`.

closed.description: Closed: one segment per point, last wraps to first. Open: one fewer segment than points.

start_percent.description: Trims the drawn start of the curve as a fraction of its length. Observed constant -0.1 (slightly past the true start) in every sample - not read by moho2svg.py, which would draw the whole curve regardless of a keyframed value here (e.g. Moho's "line draws itself on" effect).

end_percent.description: As start_percent, trimming the end. Observed constant 1.1 in every sample.

profile_layer_uuid.description: A "curve profile" that repeats another curve's shape along this one. Empty in every sample; not read by moho2svg.py.

profile_repeat.description: Observed constant 16 in every sample where profile is unset.

CurvePoint.description: One vertex of a Curve, referencing a MeshPoint by index plus the curvature data used to reconstruct explicit Bezier handles (see docs/moho-project-file-format.md §7.5: handle length = distance_to_neighbour * smoothness * weight, confirmed exact against 209 reference handles; handle direction is a chord-length-weighted blend of the two neighbouring chords, NOT a simple normalize(next-prev)). weight_in/weight_out/offset_in/offset_out are OPTIONAL - an older sampled document (format version 1021) carries only point/smoothness/segments_on on every curve point, with no weight or offset fields at all (presumably a simpler, symmetric-handle-only curve representation predating the asymmetric weight/offset feature).

smoothness.description: Curvature; 0 = sharp corner (handles collapse onto the point).

weight_in.description: How far the incoming handle reaches toward its neighbour, as a fraction of the distance to it.

offset_in.description: A small rotation in radians, producing asymmetric curves.

segments_on.description: Whether the segment LEAVING this point is drawn at all. false creates a real, deliberate gap in the outline (confirmed: an umbrella panel that only shows part of its boundary as a drawn line). For a combo_mode==3 (intersect) shape specifically, a false segment can instead mark a piece of curve Moho's own boolean solver replaced with a computed crossing edge - moho2svg.py handles that case by NOT dropping the segment and relying on the intersect-clip to cut it correctly (see Shape.combo_mode below and the module docstring's BOOLEAN SHAPE COMBINATIONS section).

Edges.description: A shape's boundary as an UNORDERED set of curve segments - three parallel arrays, always equal length. NOT reliably a walk in list order, and `flag` is NOT a reliable direction bit (real files exist where segment order is strictly descending with flag 0 throughout). Must be re-traced as an undirected graph keyed by rounded endpoint coordinates - see docs/moho-project-file-format.md §7.9 and the module docstring's PathTracer.

curve.description: Index into mesh.curves for each edge.

segment.description: Index into that curve's segment list (segment i runs from curve_point[i] to curve_point[i+1]).

flag.description: Observed 0 (majority) or 1. NOT a reliable direction bit - do not trust it for path-walk order.

Shape.description: One filled/stroked region of a mesh. See docs/moho-project-file-format.md §7.4/§7.8 and the module docstring's BOOLEAN SHAPE COMBINATIONS section.

id.description: Shape identity, referenced by mesh.shape_order (an id registry, not a z-order).

name.description: Editor label, e.g. "S1", or "" (empty is a real value Moho itself writes, e.g. for a TextLayer glyph's synthesised shapes - distinct from the key being entirely absent).

combo_mode.description: How this shape combines with the shape(s) immediately before it in the same layer. 0 = normal (starts a new independent group). 1 = union (merged into the current group; the shared boundary disappears; the combined outline is stroked using the group's FIRST/base member's own styling, not its own - confirmed: a union member's own line_width is absent from Moho's export). 3 = intersect (clipped to the union of the group's solid (0 or 1) members so far - moho2svg.py approximates this via SVG masking, not a true geometric path intersection, which can leave a gap in a member's own outline where Moho's real boolean solver would substitute a computed crossing edge - fixed for the plain-stroke case by not dropping segments_on==false segments on an intersect member and letting the clip cut them). 2 has been reported in real files but its effect has not been reverse-engineered (absent from every document censused so far). ABSENT from the shape entirely in older-generation (version 1038-era) documents - treat a missing combo_mode as 0.

style.description: The shape's own style values (same shape as a top-level named Style, see style.schema.json). May be fully populated (newer-generation documents) or left with every define_* flag false and real values kept in a document-wide named style referenced by inherited_style_uuid/name (older-generation documents) - see docs/moho-project-file-format.md §8.2.

effect_rotation.description: Gradient rotation in radians, default 0.0. Only affects a LINEAR gradient - a radial gradient ignores rotation entirely (see docs/moho-export-pipeline.md §7.4).

effect_offset.description: A gradient centre offset. The formula supports it but nothing observed supplies a non-zero value.

fill_allowed.description: Presumably "this shape may be filled at all", distinct from has_fill. Interaction with has_fill is undecoded.

combo_blend_anim.description: Presumably animates a soft boolean-combination blend. Observed only in newer-generation documents, always 0.0.
